generate_gibson_large_dataset: run the script to generate customized Gibson training splits for the PointNav task with quality threshold filtering
generate_pointnav_episodes: create point navigation episodes for a given scene using the Habitat simulator and generate_pointnav_episode function
safe_mkdir: create a directory safely ignoring errors if the directory already exists
filter_gibson_scenes_by_quality: filter Gibson scene files by reconstruction quality threshold from the dataset statistics JSON file
compress_dataset_to_json_gz: compress and save a PointNav dataset as a gzipped JSON file for storage
